# Project boundary

Source: working conversations with Javier G. Grandez.

`iasi-quarto` is one IASI project/repository.

Software and product documentation are artifacts of the same project. A User Guide may be a standalone Quarto project for tooling purposes, but it is not a separate IASI project or repository.

Current high-level structure includes IASI project folders, `src/iasi-quarto/` for the R package source, and `docs/` for documentary artifacts.
